Core rules for arrival checks in detail
This section covers why careful work counts

Arrival Check Standards

The Companion Animal Travel Desk must confirm that each arrival record is complete, legible, and matched to the correct traveler before the animal is accepted for transfer. Staff should read the booking file carefully, compare the listed details against the live arrival record, and note any difference at once. <<FACT F092>> Any missing document, unclear label, or mismatch must be raised without delay so that the next step is handled in the proper order.

When a traveler arrives with a companion animal, staff should use calm and respectful language and keep the exchange focused on practical needs. The desk should confirm the handoff details, check that the crate or carrier is secure, and verify that the animal is ready for onward care. If the record shows special handling notes, the employee must follow them exactly and make sure the information is shared with the right team before the animal moves on. The department expects prompt communication, and no staff member should guess at a detail or rely on memory when the file is available.

If the arrival record cannot be cleared on the first review, the employee should pause the process and seek guidance from the senior coordinator. The traveler should be told only what is needed to keep the process orderly, and all statements should remain clear, brief, and factual. Records must be updated as soon as the issue is resolved so that the next handoff is not delayed.

All desk staff must protect traveler privacy, handle papers carefully, and keep the workspace tidy during the check. This supports smooth service across Aurelia Skyways and helps the Companion Animal Travel Desk maintain consistent care from booking through pickup. For questions about a specific arrival check, contact the senior coordinator or the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
